title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #16

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which Jain teacher is linked with the bank of the Rijubalika river? (1 mark)
   A. Prahlad
   B. Lord Mahavir
   C. Valmiki
   D. Guru Nanak

2. What does Vandana mean? (1 mark)
   A. A tree
   B. An act of respect and prayer
   C. A river
   D. A meal

3. From where did Narsimha appear in the story? (1 mark)
   A. The sky at noon
   B. A boat
   C. A river
   D. A pillar in the palace

4. In which city was Guru Ram Das Ji born? (1 mark)
   A. Lumbini
   B. Nairobi
   C. Lahore
   D. Varanasi

5. How should you behave when visiting a friend's festival? (1 mark)
   A. Shout
   B. Laugh at customs
   C. Listen and ask polite questions
   D. Refuse to take part

6. Which festival comes first in the year in the lesson's timeline? (1 mark)
   A. Jamhuri Day
   B. Paryushan
   C. Madaraka Day
   D. Maha Shivratri

7. Which of these were sons of King Dasharatha? (1 mark)
   A. Lakshman, Devadatta, Ram and Bharat
   B. Prahlad, Ram and Jetha
   C. Ram, Bharat, Lakshman and Shatrughna
   D. Ram, Sigala, Bharat and Shibi

8. Who should guide children in yoga? (1 mark)
   A. A trained teacher or trusted adult
   B. A stranger
   C. Nobody
   D. A friend who has never tried

9. Which festival comes last of the three studied? (1 mark)
   A. Maha Shivratri
   B. Paryushan Parva
   C. Madaraka Day
   D. Yoga Day

10. What is the shikhara? (1 mark)
   A. The bell
   B. The floor
   C. The spire above the inner room
   D. The kitchen

11. What is the Dhammapada? (1 mark)
   A. A list of temples
   B. A long story of a king
   C. A book of maps
   D. A book of wise sayings and verses

12. What is Bhastrika called in English? (1 mark)
   A. The hare pose
   B. The bellows breath
   C. The moon pose
   D. The shining forehead breath

13. What is the benefit of Sasankasana? (1 mark)
   A. It is useless
   B. It stretches the back and shoulders and relaxes
   C. It cures every disease
   D. It makes the arms shorter

14. Why is water needed by all living things? (1 mark)
   A. Life cannot continue without it
   B. It makes things noisy
   C. It hides the sun
   D. It is always warm

15. Which element do we breathe in? (1 mark)
   A. Vayu
   B. Jal
   C. Agni
   D. Prithvi

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain the Sikh idea of Kirat Karni. (2 marks)

17. Describe an experiment to show that plants need water. (4 marks)

18. Give three ways of showing respect to any scripture. (3 marks)

19. Describe how to pray well. (4 marks)

20. Explain the meaning of the word Paramatma. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Lord Mahavir
   Lord Mahavir is believed to have become fully enlightened there.

2. B — An act of respect and prayer
   Vandana is respectful prayer.

3. D — A pillar in the palace
   The pillar broke open and he appeared.

4. C — Lahore
   He was born in Lahore.

5. C — Listen and ask polite questions
   Respect is key.

6. D — Maha Shivratri
   It is in February or March.

7. C — Ram, Bharat, Lakshman and Shatrughna
   These were the four brothers.

8. A — A trained teacher or trusted adult
   An expert can prevent injury.

9. B — Paryushan Parva
   It occurs in August or September.

10. C — The spire above the inner room
   It is the spire or dome.

11. D — A book of wise sayings and verses
   It teaches how to live wisely.

12. B — The bellows breath
   A bellows pumps air into a fire.

13. B — It stretches the back and shoulders and relaxes
   It gently stretches and relaxes.

14. A — Life cannot continue without it
   People, animals and plants all need water to live.

15. A — Vayu
   Air is Vayu.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Earning a living by honest work.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for earning and 1 mark for honest work.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: Plant bean seeds in two tins of soil. Water one tin every day and give none to the other. Compare them after one and two weeks. The watered seeds sprout and grow but the dry seeds do not.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two tins, 1 mark for different watering, 1 mark for comparing over time, 1 mark for the result.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Keep it clean, keep it in a high place, wash hands before touching it, listen quietly, follow its teachings (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: Sit quietly, fold hands, think of God with love, say thanks, ask for wisdom and kindness, and end with a promise to do good (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: The Supreme Soul, or God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.
